label: Uneasy calm
summary: The Iran war spread further around the Gulf. Houthi forces claimed six attacks on Saudi airports and oil facilities, Saudi air defences downed a drone over the Mecca region, and Iran's Revolutionary Guard said tankers struck mines in the Strait of Hormuz. North Korea fired about ten ballistic missiles, Ethiopian border fighting left displaced families hungry in Kenya, and Trump called Brazil's election a disgrace. Flash floods killed five in Syria, and an EU force helicopter crash in Bosnia killed four. There was steadier news too. The Bank of Japan said inflation had reached its 2% target for the first time since setting it 13 years ago, the EU and Canada prepared to deepen ties, and a US judge blocked a Medicaid rule that hit chronically ill people. Conjoined Fijian twins were separated successfully, and research reported progress in astronomy and brain health. The weighted formula gave 44; no editorial adjustment.
